SELECT H.EMPID, H.LOCAL_NAME, H.CHINESE_PINYIN, H.ENGLISH_NAME, H.KOREAN_NAME, H.STATUS_CODE, H.DATE_STARTED, H.JOIN_COMPANY_DATE, H.WORK_AREA, H.POSITION_NO, POSITION.CONTENT POSITION_NAME, H.POST_NO, POST.CONTENT POST_NAME, H.DEPTNO, HDN.CONTENT DEPT_NAME, EC.RECORD_TEST_NO, EC.RECORD_TEST_ADD, CASE WHEN EC.RECORD_TEST_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(EC.RECORD_TEST_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ELSE '未打卡' END RECORD_TEST_DATE, EC.RECORD_TEST_REMARK FROM (select * from ESS_RECORD_TEST where #RECORD_TEST_DATE:VARCHAR# = TO_CHAR(RECORD_TEST_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') ) EC, HR_EMPLOYEE H, SY_GLOBAL_NAME POST, SY_GLOBAL_NAME POSITION, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HDN WHERE H.PERSON_ID = EC.PERSON_ID(+) and H.DEPTNO = HDN.DEPTNO(+) AND H.POST_NO = POST.NO(+) AND H.POSITION_NO = POSITION.NO(+) AND H.Cpny_Id = #Cpny_Id:VARCHAR# AND ( H.Date_Left is null OR H.Date_Left > sysdate) AND HDN.LANGUAGE (+) = 'zh' AND POST.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND POSITION.LANGUAGE (+) = 'zh'
H.DEPTNO = #DEPT_NO:NUMBER#
EC.RECORD_TEST_DATE is null
EC.RECORD_TEST_DATE is not null
( H.EMPID like '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR H.LOCAL_NAME like '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%')
ORDER BY RECORD_TEST_DATE

SELECT count(0) FROM (select * from ESS_RECORD_TEST where #RECORD_TEST_DATE:VARCHAR# = TO_CHAR(RECORD_TEST_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') ) EC, HR_EMPLOYEE H, SY_GLOBAL_NAME POST, SY_GLOBAL_NAME POSITION, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HDN WHERE H.PERSON_ID = EC.PERSON_ID(+) and H.DEPTNO = HDN.DEPTNO(+) AND H.POST_NO = POST.NO(+) AND H.POSITION_NO = POSITION.NO(+) AND H.Cpny_Id = #Cpny_Id:VARCHAR# AND ( H.Date_Left is null OR H.Date_Left > sysdate) AND HDN.LANGUAGE (+) = 'zh' AND POST.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND POSITION.LANGUAGE (+) = 'zh'
H.DEPTNO = #DEPT_NO:NUMBER#
( H.EMPID like '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR H.LOCAL_NAME like '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%')
